mentions.author: ninethirty
mentions.story: Ask HN: Is your memory as bad as mine?
mentions.why: Example of expert memory built on care and context.
mentions.quote: Not enough context. Do you only watch football once every four years? Probably you don't care enough and have enough context of strategic moments to create memories. The more you care + context, the better the memory will be, see LeBron + Magnus. { [LINK] , [VIDEO] }
